main_text.p: He finale interdum duo habet punĉta supernè, ut [illegible, ~2 letters] & tunc pronuntiatur ut Te, & nume-rum pluralem, vel genus fœm. notat.
Dictiones non dividunt Arabes in fine linea-rum, sed ne spatium fit vacuum, lineam exten-dunt sic [illegible, ~6 letters]
Punĉta diacritica literarum in scriptis vulga-ribus sæpe omittuntur; & ubi punĉta adhiben-tur, sæpe in He finali omittuntur.
In libris quibusdam, licèt punctorum absen-tia literas quasdam ab aliis distinguat, scil. [illegible, ~8 letters] ne tamen quis opinetur omissa esse puncta ex scriptoris incu-ria

page.notes: The Arabic letter forms throughout are too small and faint on this scan to read reliably, so each is marked illegible with an estimated letter count. The Latin text is transcribed as printed. The line "ne tamen quis" is set after the Arabic letters in the scil. line, and the Arabic there is also illegible. The stray mark before "Punĉta" is not text and is left out.
